title: Double Fourier transform
statement: For every natural number $n$, every function $f:\mathbb{F}_2^n\to\mathbb{R}$, and every $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$, applying the Fourier transform twice gives $2^{-n}f(x)$ at $x$.
